description: Source-grounded close reading of academic papers with traceable page, section, figure, and table references.

defaultPrompt: Read this paper section by section with cited source locations.
Explain this paper's methods, figures, and experimental evidence.
Turn this paper into reusable, source-grounded research notes.
interface.longDescription:
Guide rigorous close reading of academic papers, methods, experiments, figures, tables, and appendices. Explanations stay grounded in source locations and can be turned into reusable research notes.

Open source on GitHub:
https://github.com/Delores-Lin/paper-close-reading

If you find it useful, consider leaving a star. For bugs, questions, or feature requests, please open an issue:
https://github.com/Delores-Lin/paper-close-reading/issues

name: paper-close-reading
